_about: Per-region bone settings for the fracture engine. All values are data; change them here, not in code.

cortex._note: MODELLED cortex (owner's decision). Thickness in mm against position along the bone (0 = proximal end, 1 = distal end), straight lines between points. Same peak and end values as the owner's earlier Tibia Fracture Lab.

sources.claim: Cortex is thickest toward the mid-diaphysis
sources.ref: Capozza RF et al. J Anat 2010;216:470-81

sources.claim: Anterior cortex is thicker than posterior; medial and lateral do not differ
sources.ref: Maeda K et al. J Exp Orthop 2020;7:78

sources.claim: Medullary diameter 13-32 mm between 20 and 80 % of tibial length (used as a check of the model)
sources.ref: Taylor CE et al. Anat Rec 2020;303:2847-56

cortex._note: MODELLED cortex. Same values as the owner's earlier Tibia Fracture Lab. No published source found for these numbers.
